title: Analytics
description: How the Factory’s work flowed, and what its agents spent doing it.

scope.label: Factories
scope.workNote: Work counts this Factory’s board; usage counts every Factory you can see.

limits.note: Each sign-in’s 5-hour, weekly, model and extra-usage limits, as its provider reports them. API keys have none.
limits.empty: No sign-in reports limits yet. Claude Code and Codex sign-ins show theirs here once read; API keys (Mastra) have no subscription limits.

kpi.tokensChart: Tokens per day: input, cache reads, cache writes and output
kpi.costChart: Cost per day, estimated at API list prices
kpi.cacheShareChart: Share of each day’s input read from cache

queue.label: Queue health
queue.description: Live snapshot of in-flight work by time in its current stage — not scoped to the date range.

intake.label: Work intake
intake.description: Where new work entered during this period.

coverage.label: Automation coverage
coverage.description: First pass through each stage, finished by an agent rather than a person.

harness.label: Harness
harness.description: Tokens by the harness that ran each turn.

model.label: Model
model.description: Tokens by the model that answered.

role.label: Role
role.description: Tokens by the role a card run played.

account.label: Account
account.description: Tokens by the sign-in or key that paid for them.

intake.emptyDescription: Nothing entered the board in this window.

coverage.emptyDescription: Stages show up here once a card finishes its first pass through them.
coverage.tooltip: {{byAgent}} of {{passes}} passes run by an agent

usage.emptyDescription: No agent spent tokens in this window.

empty.title: Your analytics start here
empty.description: Start work on the board: completions, queue health and the tokens agents spend show up here.
empty.rangeTitle: Nothing happened in the last {{count}} days
